title: A Confession for the Inheritance
premise: When a confession letter arrives at the taxi dispatch office postmarked the day after old man Corliss's funeral, night dispatcher Astrid Yarrow realizes it names her late brother as an accessory to murder—and claims a witness saw everything. The letter's author, Corliss himself, insists the witness is dead, but Astrid's seven years of filing the town's secrets tell her otherwise. Following fare records and radio logs through the town's buried history, she uncovers that the witness is alive, hidden by the very family now contesting the inheritance. In the end, Astrid must choose between protecting the man she loves—who helped bury the truth to survive—and delivering the confession that will cost him everything but free them both.
about_author: Rafael Vane is the pen name of a former small-town court clerk who spent a decade listening to confessions that never made the record. He writes mysteries about ordinary people who know too much.

chapters.title: Postmarked the Day After
chapters.summary: Astrid Yarrow, working the quiet night shift at Yarrow Taxi Dispatch, opens a letter from the recently deceased Edmund Corliss confessing to a hit-and-run seven years ago—the same night her brother Daniel disappeared from town. POV: Astrid. Emotional beat: dread disguised as routine; her ordered world cracks open with one envelope.

chapters.title: The Alphabet of Small Towns
chapters.summary: Astrid searches her private archive of fare logs and overheard secrets, finding that Corliss's confession contradicts the official record: the police report names no witness, yet the letter swears 'she saw everything.' POV: Astrid. Emotional beat: the thrill and guilt of realizing her invisibility made her the town's true historian.

chapters.title: The Widow's Arithmetic
chapters.summary: At the reading of the will, Corliss's nephew Marcus contests the estate, and his lawyer hints the confession letter is a forgery. Astrid observes how desperately the family wants it discredited. POV: Astrid. Emotional beat: suspicion curdling into certainty—someone fears the witness more than the confession itself.

chapters.title: Fare 447
chapters.summary: Digging through seven-year-old dispatch logs, Astrid finds a fare logged the night of the accident to Hollow Creek Road—a route no driver would take without reason—signed out under her brother's badge number. POV: Astrid. Emotional beat: grief sharpening into resolve as Daniel's name surfaces in the crime she's chasing.

chapters.title: What the Radio Heard
chapters.summary: Retired driver Sal Kowalski, half-drunk and frightened, admits he drove Corliss home that night and heard him say 'the girl on the bridge saw us.' He begs Astrid to let sleeping dogs lie. POV: Astrid. Emotional beat: the first confirmation the witness exists—and the first threat, delivered gently, to stop looking.

chapters.title: The Girl on the Bridge
chapters.summary: Astrid traces the description to Lena Marsh, a schoolteacher who supposedly died in a car accident six years ago—but whose death certificate bears Marcus's signature as informant. POV: alternating Astrid and flashbacks from Lena. Emotional beat: hope entangled with horror; the dead woman has been living in plain sight.

chapters.title: Love Against Duty
chapters.summary: Astrid confronts Tom Reave, the sheriff she's quietly loved for years, and discovers he knew Lena lived—he helped stage her death to protect her from the Corliss family, and he buried Daniel's involvement to protect Astrid. POV: Astrid. Emotional beat: betrayal and tenderness colliding; every loyalty she trusted was a debt someone else paid.

chapters.title: Statute of Limitations
chapters.summary: With eleven days before the statute expires, Marcus's men ransack the dispatch office for the original fare log. Astrid hides the page, then finds a second letter from Corliss naming where Lena can be found—if she's brave enough to look. POV: Astrid. Emotional beat: cornered courage; the price of survival has always been silence, and she refuses to pay it again.

chapters.title: Hollow Creek
chapters.summary: Astrid finds Lena living under another name and persuades her to testify, but Marcus intercepts them on the road; Tom arrives and arrests Marcus for tampering, forcing the truth into the open. POV: Astrid. Emotional beat: the climax—fear transmuted into testimony as Lena finally speaks what she saw on the bridge.

chapters.title: A Confession for the Inheritance
chapters.summary: In probate court, Lena's testimony voids Marcus's claim and validates Corliss's final act of conscience; Daniel is cleared of complicity, and Tom resigns rather than lie again. Astrid files the last secret in her archive—her own. POV: Astrid. Emotional beat: bittersweet resolution; truth costs everything except the self, which it returns.
